scores.label: A
scores.note: Strong top two. Options 3, 4 and 6 are plain near-synonyms. Five of the ten slots are duplicate 'substantial' fails, so the list has little variety.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Best options come first. 'remarkable' and 'drastic' add a judgment the original lacks. 'massive' is a little casual. Option 9 fails as a duplicate.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Option 7 'extended' is 0: wrong sense, since it means duration, not magnitude, and 'extended changes' misstates the claim. Option 1 'vast' is an awkward pairing with 'changes', and it sits first ahead of stronger picks. 'widespread' moves the meaning toward geographic reach. Options 9 and 10 fail as duplicates.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Good top two. 'huge' is casual for an essay and 'large' is plain. Three duplicate fails (options 6, 9 and 10) cut the variety.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Option 7 'far' is 0: 'far changes' is ungrammatical in place, apparently a cut-down 'far-reaching'. The top four are all strong, with 'profound' and 'far-reaching' as good extra picks. 'drastic' slightly overstates.
